skill.name: google-maps-reviews-api-skill
skill.description: Extracts public Google Maps reviews through the BrowserAct Google Maps Reviews API workflow. It starts a BrowserAct task from keywords, language, and country inputs, then polls task status.
skill.summary: Starts and monitors BrowserAct Google Maps review extraction tasks.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate BrowserAct client, and many Markdown backtick and reconnaissance alerts are false positives. Confirmed risks remain around authenticated outbound API calls, environment secret handling, chat-based API key solicitation, public reviewer data collection, and a result retrieval control-flow bug.

remediation.issue: The skill asks users to provide a BrowserAct API key to the agent when the environment variable is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through a local secret manager or environment configuration, and never ask for the raw key in chat.

remediation.issue: The script sends search parameters and the API key to BrowserAct endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Document the outbound domain, request purpose, and data sent before execution, and ask for confirmation before broad or sensitive searches.

remediation.issue: Successful task results are unreachable because the function returns a timeout immediately after the polling loop.
remediation.suggestion: Track whether the task finished, fetch results only after success, and return timeout only when the polling limit is actually exceeded.

remediation.issue: The documented output includes reviewer profile and avatar links that can be personal data.
remediation.suggestion: Add privacy guidance, minimize retained fields, and avoid collecting reviews at scale without a lawful basis and terms review.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Solicitation in User Conversation
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to ask users to provide the BrowserAct API key if it is not configured, and the script repeats that users may provide the key to the agent. This can move a secret from a controlled environment variable into chat history or logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prose explicitly directs the agent to ask for the API key, and the script prints that the user can provide it to the agent. This is direct evidence of unsafe secret collection guidance.

semantic_findings.title: Public Reviewer Personal Data Collection
semantic_findings.description: The documented output includes reviewer names, profile URLs, review text, dates, like counts, and avatar URLs. This is public review data, but it can still create privacy and compliance risk when collected at scale.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output section lists personal and profile-related fields returned from Google Maps reviews. The risk is contextual rather than malicious, so confidence is high but severity is medium.

semantic_findings.title: Successful Result Retrieval Is Unreachable
semantic_findings.description: After a finished status, the polling loop breaks, but the function then prints a timeout error and returns before the result retrieval block. This can cause false failure reports and duplicate automated collection attempts under the retry guidance.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The control flow shows an unconditional timeout return before the result retrieval code, and the skill instructs a retry for failed or empty results. This directly supports the business-logic finding.

content.user_title: Extract Google Maps Reviews with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Teams need structured local review data without manual copying from Google Maps. This skill starts BrowserAct review extraction tasks and monitors their status from an AI assistant.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct Google Maps Reviews workflow from search keywords.
Accepts language and country inputs for the BrowserAct task.
Reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the local environment for authorization.
Polls BrowserAct task status and prints timestamped progress logs.
Reports invalid authorization and connection failures to the user.
Documents expected review fields such as reviewer name, rating, text, date, likes, profile URL, and avatar URL.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and sends queries to BrowserAct external services.
The current script has a result retrieval bug that can return a timeout after success.
It does not perform sentiment analysis or summarization by itself.
It does not validate search terms, language codes, or country codes beyond simple defaults.

use_cases.title: Research Local Service Quality
use_cases.description: Collect public reviews for cafes, clinics, stores, or venues in a selected country and language.

use_cases.title: Monitor Location Reputation
use_cases.description: Track customer feedback for a brand location and prepare review text for later analysis.

use_cases.title: Compare Nearby Competitors
use_cases.description: Gather review data for competing businesses before benchmarking ratings, complaints, and praise.

prompt_templates.title: Single Business Review Pull
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one business or place.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google Maps reviews skill to collect public reviews for Bright Dental Austin in English for the United States. Tell me if the API key is not configured.

prompt_templates.title: Category Research in One City
prompt_templates.scenario: Collect reviews for a local business category.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Google Maps reviews for coffee shops in Portland, Oregon. Use English and United States settings, then summarize the task status and any returned review fields.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Review Benchmark
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare several named locations after extraction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect reviews for these three competitor gyms in Chicago. After the extraction task finishes, organize the available ratings and common review themes for comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Privacy-Aware Monitoring Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with secret handling and data minimization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a privacy-aware review monitoring workflow for our new restaurant location. Use the environment API key only, avoid storing profile links unless needed, and report any execution errors clearly.

output_examples.input: Collect reviews for a dental clinic in Austin with English and United States settings.
output_examples.output: The assistant starts a BrowserAct review task, shows status updates, and reports whether the task finished, failed, or timed out.

output_examples.input: Research coffee shop reviews in Seattle for competitor analysis.
output: Review extraction task started with the selected search terms.
Status updates are shown while BrowserAct processes the task.
Returned review fields can be used for later rating and theme analysis.

output_examples.input: Run the skill without a configured BrowserAct API key.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports that the API key is missing and should be configured through the local environment before running the task.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in a local environment or secret manager, not in chat.
Use specific search terms to reduce unnecessary data collection and noisy results.
Review privacy, platform terms, and retention needs before collecting reviewer profile data.
anti_patterns: Do not ask users to paste raw API keys into the assistant conversation.
Do not run broad review collection jobs without a clear purpose and consent review.
Do not treat extracted reviews as complete sentiment analysis without separate validation.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be configured in the local environment before execution.

faq.question: Does the skill contact external services?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends task requests and status checks to the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: Can it analyze sentiment automatically?
faq.answer: No. It collects review data for later analysis, but sentiment analysis is a separate step.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide search keywords, a language code, and a country or region code.

faq.question: What data can be returned?
faq.answer: The documented output includes reviewer names, ratings, review text, dates, likes, profile URLs, and avatar URLs.

faq.question: Is the current script fully reliable?
faq.answer: No. The audit found a control-flow bug that can prevent successful result retrieval after the task finishes.
